title: [Bug] Excessive token usage for short messages (4% usage for "hi")
body:
**Bug Description**

- Terminal: WarpTerminal

top_comments.author: yurukusa
top_comments.body:
The EISDIR errors in your log are the smoking gun — here's the token drain mechanism:
1. Claude tries to orient itself by reading paths like `src/tools/shared`, `src/services/api`
2. Those are **directories**, not files → each attempt throws `EISDIR: illegal operation on a directory, read`
3. Claude retries with different directory paths (6 times in ~30 seconds in your log)
4. Every tool call round-trip re-sends the full conversation context to the API, so even failed reads burn tokens
